title: A space-time finite element formulation for geometrically exact shear-deformable beams
summary: We present a space-time finite element formulation for the transient analysis of geometrically exact shear-deformable beams. The formulation treats space and time within a unified finite element framework and employs a mixed approach in which translational and angular velocities are introduced as independent fields. The rotation field is parametrized using nodal rotation (pseudo-)vectors and a suitable objective interpolation of the triad field is employed.
